summary: Make & Cook Delicious Ice Cream Cone Food Recipes in a fun Food Game for Girls
description:
Do you love Ice Cream, Cupcake Cones, and Glitter Desserts? Do you love Cooking Games, Food Maker Games, and Food Making Girl Games?

Then you will love Mermaid Glitter Cupcake Chef - Ice Cream Cone Cupcake Bakery Food Games and food making games for girls!

Mermaid Unicorn Glitter Cupcake Chef invites you to create and design your very own Cupcake Cones with Real Cupcake filling inside!

Select from one of many delicious varieties of Cupcake Cones and get started in making your creation of Ice Cream Cone Cupcakes!

Bake cupcakes, eat cake, and enjoy making games in Ice Cream Cone cupcake bakery for girls!

Choose From a Mermaid Cupcake Cone, Chocolate Waffle Cupcakes, Plain Waffle Cupcakes or Unicorn Cupcake Cones!

Become a Cupcake Cone Chef, and mix and make the batter for the waffles! The cones look like Ice Cream Scoop cones, but are actually baked Cupcake Cones!

Pour the delicious batter into the waffle maker, and press the waffle maker down until it's crisp and cooked!

Next, mix up the cupcake batter using all the delicious ingredients in your sweet kitchen!

Pour the batter into the cones, and watch them rise in the oven!

Decorate your special Cupcake Cones with delicious frosting, candy, and toppings!

Features include:

- Gorgeous graphics with delicious and realistic looking cupcake cones that look delectable on screen!

- Professional Voice overs provided by a celebrity voice over artist for instructions and helpful tips!

- Sound FX and Animations that will delight girls that love to cook in the kitchen!

- Many options and choices to cook in the kitchen with blenders, machines, and more!

- A really fun game for girls who love to select from tons of recipes - for cooking and girl food game lovers!

- Colorful Rainbow Cupcakes & Frosting will make you want to run to the Grocery Store and pick up a cupcake!

- Become a Unicorn Chef with Mermaid Cooking and Baking fever as some of the best experiences you will have with this game!

- Create unique Cupcake Ice Cream Cones, and trick your friends into thinking it's ice cream, when they are actually baked cupcakes with frosting!

Enjoy becoming a Mermaid Glitter Cupcake Chef, and make recipes that will delight the entire family!
